spans.text: Read all relevant code files in full with no truncation and compare against the diff.
spans.note: The prompt promotes thoroughness and accuracy by requiring the system to read all PR content, linked issues, and full code files without truncation. It instructs careful analysis comparing diffs against actual code, and structures the review to surface concrete issues, risks, and open questions rather than fabricating conclusions.

spans.text: Analyze the PR diff without checking out or switching to the PR branch. Use `gh pr diff`, `gh pr view`, `gh api`, and local main-branch files; if PR file contents are needed, use fetched refs with `git show <ref>:<path>` or temporary files.

spans.text: Open questions for you: only things blocking a merge decision that need the user's input. Omit the section entirely if there are none.
spans.note: The prompt preserves user agency by including an 'Open questions for you' section specifically for things that need user input before a merge decision. It also instructs the system to omit that section if there are no blocking questions, avoiding unnecessary prompting.
